_README: Human judgments for the Grounding column of traceability-tanakh.md. Merged at build time by 5-machinery/scripts/build_traceability_index.py so regenerating the table never discards curation. Values: GROUNDED (source asserts the unit coheres AND that this bears on segmentation) | DESCRIBED (source establishes the phenomenon; the segmentation inference is ours) | PROJECT (no external source, a deliberate engineering decision) | UNGROUNDED (neither source nor rationale). Absent constraints render as UNVERIFIED. Only add an entry you can defend from the cited section itself -- a guess here is worse than a blank, because a blank is visibly a gap.
